major.comment: refactor!: replace source APIs with atomic snapshots
major.author: Helmuth Saatkamp <helmuthdu@gmail.com>

minor.comment: refactor(sourcerer): add dev-diagnostics layer, rename SourceTimeoutError/SourceDisposedError to SourcererTimeoutError/SourcererDisposedError for consistency with the SourcererError base, remove applyQuery() (use source.patch() directly), add debugSource() devtools sub-path (works with mergeSource() too, which has no meta), localSource reuses the shared debounced-search coordinator, mergeSource/deriveSource auto-dispose once every parent disposes (routed through the public dispose() method), sanitize untrusted decodeQuery() input before logging it, dedupe clampPositiveInt's dev warning per call site. core.ts stays a plain Set-based pub/sub (no @vielzeug/ripple dependency) after finding a real SSR/concurrent-request risk in ripple's scheduler for prefetchSource()'s documented SSR use case
minor.author: Helmuth Saatkamp <helmuthdu@gmail.com>

patch.comment: chore: bump engines.node to >=22 to match .nvmrc/CLAUDE.md's Node 22 requirement
patch.author: Helmuth Saatkamp <helmuthdu@gmail.com>

patch.comment: fix: align async search orchestration and stale optimistic refresh
patch.author: Helmuth Saatkamp <helmuthdu@gmail.com>

patch.comment: fix: rewrite workspace:* deps to real semver on publish (was shipping literal 'workspace:*' to npm, breaking installs outside this monorepo)
patch.author: Helmuth Saatkamp <helmuthdu@gmail.com>

patch.comment: chore: declare minimum supported Node.js version (>=18) in package.json engines

patch.comment: fix(sourcerer): this-binding hazard breaks destructured methods, async filter/sort pipeline never ran on construction, immediate search()/patch() ignored a pending same-text debounce, LocalSource silently swallowed filterAsync/sortAsync errors
patch.author: Helmuth Saatkamp <helmuthdu@gmail.com>
